definitions.explanation: A small cup for drinking sake, larger than a {猪口|ちょこ}. Often prized as a piece of pottery.

examples.japanese: ぐい{呑|の}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: to drink sake from a sake cup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅先|たびさき}→旅先：12949_tabisaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}った→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧ぐい{呑|の}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a sake cup I liked while traveling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ぐい{呑|の}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧だ。
examples.english: My father's hobby is collecting ceramic sake cups.

notes:
From ぐいっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ ('in one gulp') + {呑|の}み ('drinking'). A sake cup larger than a {猪口|ちょこ}, often valued as pottery and sold as a craft item.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {猪口|ちょこ}: small sake cup — smaller than a ぐい{呑|の}み
- ⟦{盃|さかずき}→盃：13677_sakazuki⟧: sake cup — a flat, shallow cup used on ceremonial occasions

WRITING:
Also written ぐい{飲|の}み; the all-kana form ぐいのみ is common as well.
